notify.received.fromOne.message: {count, plural, one {Tab received from {device}} other {# tabs received from {device}}}
notify.received.fromOne.description: Title of the system notification when tabs arrive from one device. {count} is the number of tabs; {device} the sender's name.

notify.received.fromMany.message: {count, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}} received from {devices, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}
notify.received.fromMany.description: Title of the system notification when tabs arrive from several devices. {count} is the number of tabs; {devices} is the number of devices.

notify.arrival.window.message: {count, plural, one {{title} — opened in the window with “{windowTitle}”. Click to show it.} other {# tabs — opened in the window with “{windowTitle}”. Click to show the first.}}
notify.arrival.window.description: Body of the arrival notification: where the tab opened. {title} is the page title, {windowTitle} the title of the tab showing in that window, {count} the number of tabs. Keep it short; notifications are clipped.

notify.arrival.background.message: {count, plural, one {{title} — opened in a background tab. Click to show it.} other {# tabs — opened in background tabs. Click to show the first.}}
notify.arrival.background.description: Body of the arrival notification when the tab opened behind the current one. {title} is the page title, {count} the number of tabs. Keep it short.

notify.arrival.newTab.message: {count, plural, one {{title} — opened in a new tab. Click to show it.} other {# tabs — opened in new tabs. Click to show the first.}}
notify.arrival.newTab.description: Body of the arrival notification when the browser could not say where the tab opened. {title} is the page title, {count} the number of tabs. Keep it short.
